title: Introduce proactive circuit prober and gradual evacuation stabilizer
author: Ayesha Khan
description:
Motivation: We observed repeated regional oscillations during transient overloads where immediate evacuation + aggressive circuit flips caused thrash and slow recovery. This PR introduces two coordinated mechanisms that reduce oscillation risk and make regional failovers softer: (1) a proactive circuit prober that continuously probes candidate fallback regions and updates circuit state with probabilistic confidence scoring, and (2) a gradual evacuation stabilizer that moves traffic out of an overloaded region in bounded steps with hysteresis windows.

Design summary: the circuit prober runs as a lightweight probe runner inside the serving control-plane with configurable probe types (health, short-path latency, a minimal inference request) and per-region confidence decay. Probes feed into an updated circuit-state machine: instead of immediate open/close flips, circuits transition to a PROBING state where decisions are weighted by a rolling confidence score. The evacuation stabilizer subscribes to circuit state + SLO telemetry and, when evacuation is triggered, ramps egress percentage in discrete ticks (default: 5% steps every 30s) until either the target region returns to healthy or a maximum egress cap is reached. Hysteresis prevents rejoin until multiple consecutive healthy probe windows succeed.

Configuration and knobs: feature flag (evac-stabilizer-enabled) for staged rollout; probe_interval_seconds (default 10s); probe_window_seconds (default 60s); probe_confidence_threshold (default 0.85); evac_step_percent (default 5); evac_step_interval_seconds (default 30); evac_max_percent (default 80); rejoin_required_good_windows (default 3). All knobs live in serving/config/evac_config and can be overridden per-tenant in dedicated deployments.

Telemetry and observability: new metrics emitted: prober.probe_latency_ms{region,type}, prober.probe_success_rate{region}, circuit.confidence_score{region}, evac.progress_percent{region}, evac.step_events_total{region,result}. Added structured traces for probe sequences and a dashboard prototype (dashboards/evac_stabilizer.json) that surfaces probe timelines and evacuation steps for on-call.

Safety and rollout: implemented canary rollout (10% traffic regionally) gated by feature flag and Linear tasks ENG-1842/ENG-1899. Added circuit probe dry-run mode so we can exercise logic without performing actual egress. Backout: setting evac-stabilizer-enabled=false or forcing evac_max_percent=0 disables evacuation and returns circuit machine to existing behavior.

Testing and validation: unit tests for confidence aggregation and hysteresis logic; integration test that simulates a noisy region with intermittent latency spikes and verifies no >2 toggles in a 10-minute window. Load test in benchmark-lab showed a 37% reduction in rejoin oscillations and a 12% improvement in downstream tail latency during overload windows.

Migration notes: no customer-facing API changes. Default behavior is behind feature flag; recommend enabling in staging for 72 hours, then canary to 5% of production traffic before progressive rollout.

Why this is different: previous solutions attempted aggressive immediate failover or depended solely on SLO breaches. This approach explicitly measures candidate fallback health, smooths evacuation, and ties rejoin policies to multiple good windows to reduce flip-flopping.

review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Overall looks good. Two asks: 1) make probe payload size configurable and small by default, 2) add a slowpath circuit metric so SRE can detect when probes are missing. Response: obrigado — probe payload is now configurable (probe_types.go) and prober emits probe_missing_total metric.

Priya Patel: Can we avoid tenant-wide config change? Suggest per-tenant opt-in. Response: added per-tenant override via serving/config/evac_config and documented how to set in Dedicated clusters; default remains off for tenants.

Ethan Cole: Concerned about DAG ordering when multiple regions are evacuated concurrently. Response: stabilizer serializes evacuation per-tenant and records causality in traces; added unit test to validate ordering and added a small backoff jitter to reduce thundering herd.
ci_checks: integration: evacuation_sim - flake on first run (timing), rerun -> pass
release_notes: Adds a proactive circuit prober and a gradual evacuation stabilizer to reduce regional failover oscillations. Behind feature flag evac-stabilizer-enabled. New telemetry and dashboard available for on-call. Default off for tenants; can be enabled per-tenant in Dedicated deployments.
notes_for_oncall: If you see repeated rapid evacuation/rejoin events after enabling, disable evac-stabilizer-enabled and set evac_max_percent=0; check prober.probe_success_rate and circuit.confidence_score for probe anomalies. See docs/ops/evacuation-runbook.md for steps.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover confidence decay and rejoin hysteresis. Integration simulation demonstrates reduction in oscillations under noisy latency profiles. Benchmark-lab shows improved tail latency during controlled overloads.
risk_assessment: Low to medium. Changes are control-plane only and behind feature flag; misconfiguration could cause slower evacuation (traffic stays longer in degraded region) but not data loss. Added safety caps (evac_max_percent) and rapid disable path.
manual_backout: Set EVAC_STABILIZER_ENABLED=false in control plane config, restart control-plane, or set evac_max_percent=0 via config API. Reversions available in main if immediate rollback required.
acknowledgements: Thanks to SRE on-call rotation (Rita Gomez) for incident logs and to the benchmark-lab team for the noisy-region harness.
